grh_4834cacdb7d5c3a49cf8.title: Room Service
paragraphs: Shoestring producer Gordon Miller has housed his entire cast in a hotel run by his brother-in-law while desperately waiting for financing for a new play. When the hotel chain's hard-nosed executive arrives demanding payment, Gordon and his company invent illnesses, deaths and other increasingly wild excuses to keep their rooms and protect young playwright Leo Davis's show. Their schemes finally collide with a visiting senator and potential sponsor, and the play is saved when the supposedly disastrous production wins the backing it needs.

The surviving recording runs about 25 minutes. The broadcast is also associated with [[org|org.abcd644a2f6dc047|Old Gold]].
This version presents a radio version of [[work|work.oldgold.a757090457c1bb89|Room Service]].
This surviving item is preserved as afrs rebroadcast.
